blocks.text: An authorization grant represents a user's authorization for an API client or AI agent to access Zscaler API resources on their behalf. Using the Authorization Code grant type, the client obtains an access token based on the user's authorization and selected administrative roles.
You can view and manage authorization grants in the Zscaler Admin Console to monitor and control access to API resources.
Authorization grants provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: View and monitor authorization grants issued to API clients and AI agents across your organization.
Track the users, administrative roles, and expiration dates associated with authorization grants.
Administratively revoke authorization grants and stop access to Zscaler API resources.

blocks.text: On the Authorization Grants page (Administration > API > Authorization Grants), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for authorization grants by grant ID or user who authorized the grant.
Add or remove columns from the table.
View the list of authorization grants. For each grant, you can view:
API Client: The API client or AI agent associated with the authorization grant.
Grant ID: The unique identifier of the authorization grant.
Authorized By: The user who authorized the API client or AI agent.
Scopes: The administrative roles and permissions delegated to the API client or AI agent.
Authorized At: The date and time when the authorization grant was created.
Expires At: The date and time when the authorization grant expires.
Revoke the authorization grant. To revoke the authorization grant, click Revoke, and in the Revoke Grant window, click Revoke.
Limit the number of records displayed per page. You can choose to display 10, 25, 50, or 100 entries per page.
Go to a specific page or move to the next or previous page.
